title: Generic query-directed propositional entailment with independently verifiable SAT witnesses
independentExamples: A 96-symbol nonce implication chain with 300 satisfiable premises in disconnected semantic components
Two hundred deterministic generated theories checked against exhaustive finite-model semantics
A renamed and reordered implication theory with reversed commutative operands
An inconsistent theory evaluated under both report-only and explicit classical-explosion policies
preconditions: Formula syntax uses only atom, not, and, or, and implies operators.
The semantic atom set is finite.
Every execution uses validated positive integer resource bounds.
Classical explosion is used only when the task explicitly selects that inconsistency policy.
invariants: The solver never branches on benchmark, dataset, record, source row, hash, expected answer, or vocabulary constants.
Every omitted query-irrelevant component is disconnected by the transitive semantic-atom incidence closure.
The complete premise set is proved satisfiable before disconnected components may be omitted from query search.
A returned countermodel satisfies every complete premise and falsifies the query.
An entailment or inconsistency result carries a replayable DPLL certificate tied to a deterministic CNF digest.
Resource exhaustion changes status, never the input denominator or retained source corpus.
uncertaintySemantics: The default policy reports an inconsistent premise set as INCONSISTENT_CONTEXT. An explicit classical-explosion policy returns entailed with the same independently verifiable inconsistency certificate. Bounded search returns RESOURCE_LIMIT and never guesses.
proofBehavior: Formulas are compiled by deterministic Tseitin transformation. The solver first checks the complete context. For a consistent context it constructs the transitive query dependency cone, searches that cone with the negated query, and returns either a DPLL unsatisfiability tree or a complete semantic countermodel. A separate verifier recompiles the formulas and replays the certificate or evaluates the countermodel.

resourceBounds.policy: Bounds constrain one execution and produce a witnessed RESOURCE_LIMIT. They do not reject, delete, sample away, or reduce the denominator of any source corpus.

failureStatuses: schema validation error for malformed formulas or budgets
kbMigration: None. The change is a generic reasoning method over typed formula ASTs and does not add facts, source vocabulary, benchmark conventions, or executable KB payloads.
